notes.title: Update v.1.4.44.89
notes.content:
Hello all Microbes and Machines players!
In this update v.1.4.44.89 some very important things were done that I had noted based on your feedbacks.

Improvements


 Added screen resolution options
 Added option to enable/disable screen shake effect
 Added new smooth camera system
 Balancing damage and bullet velocity on some weapons
 added glow effect


bugs


 Fixed an issue where skins would not unlock in the endgame leaderboard


Thank you to all the players and the staff who sent in the feedback. Thank you very much!! ^-^
Coming soon...a new game...

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593104/81a24cede6f21d935b61c523ec9621aec3324a30.png

Improvements made


 The scoring system for a lost match has been improved.
 Now the player can unlock new main weapons, support weapons and advanced upgrades.
 The game's final score has also been modified.
 The player will be able to unlock new optional skins and bosses after completing the game.
 Weapon support appears in all starting rooms in any level.
 Added 5 more new achievements.
 Added sound effects for, chests, bomb item, among others.
 Now, every time the main weapon runs out of energy, a projectile will fall from the weapon to notify the player that they need to release the fire button to reload.
 Now all achieved achievements will be shown in the upper right corner of the screen.
 Now the name and description of each achievement will be shown at the cursor position.
 New main weapons and support weapons have been added.
 Some effects and particles on enemy death have been improved.


Note: During my work on this update, some bugs were found that were fixed, but others may end up appearing so your feedback is very important.

Thank you very much!!(^-^)!!

notes.title: Update 1.2.16.56
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed

 Fixed the bug where rooms were impossible to access (bosses and items rooms)


Improvements

 Upgrade icons shown on the map screen have been modified and repositioned
 Map system has been improved
 Map icons have been edited

notes.title: Update 1.2.12.52
notes.content:
Bugs fixed


 Fixed bug where chests that drop bombs and life item were duplicated on crafting


Improvements


 Added new control type "C" where aiming is not automatic
 Support weapons are now following the player in disabled mode and not shown on the HUD
 Information popup of collected items and chosen improvements has been modified

notes.title: Bugs fixed and improvements
notes.content:
Bugs fixed


 When collecting the vital energy bubble, the correct amount of health gained was not shown
 During the boss fight, more enemies were created than usual


Improvements


 Added dead zone on controller axes
 The crosshair sprite has been edited to improve visibility during gameplay
 The distance to access the transport tube has been decreased to improve player interaction in the starting room

notes.title: Bug fixed
notes.content:
Bug fixed


Fixed bug where Bomb Item Chest was not created during map update.

notes.title: updade 1.2.9.37
notes.content:
ADDED ITEMS


Added bomb item that can be used to destroy barriers to enter the main boss room.
Added particles that show the name and amount of items collected.


IMPROVEMENTS


The ice cream weapon now deals base damage in addition to the character's weapon base damage.
The umbrella weapon now deflects bullets towards the nearest target.

notes.title: Update v.1.0.7.30
notes.content:
FIXED BUGS

Fixed the bug where the path to the boss room was closed
Fixed bug where player could not access next elevator while xp bonus was added to current xp


IMPROVEMENTS

Added two control types for controllers and mouse/keyboard
